jobId.title: Job ID
jobId.description: Job ID on its site (IDs are per site).

site.title: Site
site.description: Where the job is listed: hirist (hirist.tech) or iimjobs (iimjobs.com).

title.title: Job title
title.description: Job title as listed (often prefixed with the company).

designation.title: Designation
designation.description: Role name without company or specialization.

company.title: Company
company.description: Company name; null for confidential jobs.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Job locations as listed: cities, states, Remote or Anywhere in India.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: Whether the job is listed as remote or work from home.

salaryMin.title: Salary min
salaryMin.description: Minimum yearly salary in INR; null when not disclosed.

salaryMax.title: Salary max
salaryMax.description: Maximum yearly salary in INR; null when not disclosed.

salaryCurrency.title: Currency
salaryCurrency.description: Salary currency code (INR); null when not disclosed.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skill tags listed on the job.

postedAt.title: Posted
postedAt.description: When the job was posted (ISO 8601 UTC).

applicants.title: Applicants
applicants.description: Number of applications on the site.

recruiterName.title: Recruiter
recruiterName.description: Name of the recruiter who posted the job; null for confidential jobs.

jobUrl.title: Job
jobUrl.description: Job page on hirist.tech or iimjobs.com.

applyUrl.title: Apply URL
applyUrl.description: External application page, when the job is applied for off the site.

descriptionSnippet.title: Description snippet
descriptionSnippet.description: First ~300 characters of the job description (plain text), with includeDescription; null otherwise.
descriptionSnippet.example: Java Backend - Long Term Contract Experience : 6 - 9 years Location : Hyderabad ...

description.title: Description
description.description: Full job description (plain text), with includeDescription.
description.example:
Java Backend - Long Term Contract

Experience : 6 - 9 years ...

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Query of the search that found the job.

scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
scrapedAt.description: When the job was scraped (ISO 8601 UTC).
